parameters.query:
WITH snap AS (
  SELECT json_build_object(
    'metadata', json_build_object(
      'generated_at', now()::text,
      'schema_version', '008',
      'tables_count', 9,
      'encryption_version', 'pgp_sym_v1'
    ),
    'clients',           (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(c)), '[]'::json) FROM clients c),
    'projects',          (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(p)), '[]'::json) FROM projects p),
    'briefings',         (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(b)), '[]'::json) FROM briefings b),
    'design_options',    (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(d)), '[]'::json) FROM design_options d),
    'regulatory_tasks',  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(r)), '[]'::json) FROM regulatory_tasks r),
    'proposals',         (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(p2)), '[]'::json) FROM proposals p2),
    'approvals',         (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(a)), '[]'::json) FROM approvals a),
    'project_intelligence', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(pi)), '[]'::json) FROM project_intelligence pi),
    'consent_records',   (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(cr)), '[]'::json) FROM consent_records cr),
    'activity_log_30d',  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(al)), '[]'::json) FROM activity_log al WHERE created_at > now() - INTERVAL '30 days')
  ) AS snapshot
), enc AS (
  SELECT snapshot, pii_encrypt(snapshot::text) AS blob FROM snap
)
SELECT
  snapshot,
  encode(blob, 'base64') AS encrypted_b64,
  octet_length(blob) AS encrypted_size_bytes,
  octet_length(snapshot::text) AS plaintext_size_bytes
FROM enc;
